answer: A bond is refunded only after 49 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The dawn counter is kept in atlas and dune exposes each reset. A hostile operator therefore has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 49 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. Scaling to 198 identities multiplies that fee by 398 with no matching gain in influence. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
